source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Once per battle for each unit with this ability: in your Shooting phase, as this unit is picked to shoot, you may use it, and its ranged attacks then have [INDIRECT FIRE] for the rest of that phase.

fields.durationBasis: core rule 01.02.02 Persisting Rules Effects: the card states no duration, so the effect lasts for the phase in which it was applied
